content.text: Every adventurer, from the mightiest hero of legend to those just taking their first steps upon the road, had a life before they went off into the wider world with their party. In this article we’ll look at the backgrounds from the 2014 rules supplements which haven’t been reprinted and offer advice on adapting them to the current 2024 rules set. The Backgrounds are listed in alphabetical order for your convenience, so feel free to read through the lot or just jump to the one you need!

items.text: What is a Background in Dungeons & Dragons?
How have backgrounds changed in the DnD 5.5 rules?

sections.heading: What is a Background in Dungeons & Dragons?

content.text: Backgrounds were introduced in the rules as a way to help players build their characters into a more real, well-rounded person by encouraging consideration of a character’s life before becoming an adventurer. Mechanically, a character’s background gave them a set of skills and advantages relevant to their former life such as tool proficiencies they practised to earn their living.

Additionally they also offered unique thematic perks to represent the status or resources of the character such as free accommodation with a chosen faction. Whilst they were a fun feature, much treasured by those who love crafting a meticulous backstory, more mechanically-minded players often dismissed them as unimportant or trivial when building their characters. Often focusing instead on the mechanical intricacies of their character and disregarding background features entirely. Things are a little different in the 2024 rules.

sections.heading: How have backgrounds changed in the DnD 5.5 rules?

content.text: In the current edition of the rules, backgrounds are far more integral to character creation, for everyone, and your choice of background has tangible mechanical effects right from the beginning of your game via ability score increases and origin feats.

When you choose a background for your character, Sage for example, you are given the option of increasing the ability scores most relevant to that background. In the case of the Sage these are Constitution, Intelligence, and Wisdom. Players can choose to increase one of these scores by +2 and another by +1, or they can increase each of these ability scores by +1.

As they did in the 2014 rules, backgrounds also provide proficiency in two skills and one tool proficiency (everyone now gets Common +2 other languages, and vehicle proficiencies no longer exist). Finally, and perhaps most exciting, they also provide an Origin Feat.

The Player’s Handbook has official rules for using legacy backgrounds: Pick any three ability scores and any Origin Feat. While “you figure it out” certainly allows us to use this legacy content, it’s not especially inspiring and makes legacy backgrounds objectively more powerful than new or reprinted backgrounds.

Below we have summarised each of the 2014 backgrounds from the disparate tomes of 5th Edition’s storied tenure which have not (yet) been updated to the DnD 5.5 rules and offered our suggestions on how to convert them seamlessly to your 2024 DnD games.
Source: Tomb of Annihilation
You spent years exploring other cultures both in libraries and out in the world.

items.text: Tool Profiencies: One gamign set of your choice

content.text: To travel the world, study, and understand other cultures one must be resilient and adaptable. A student of culture also has a keen eye for details others might miss.
Source: Tomb of Annihilation
You have delved into the fractured, forgotten remnants of the past to uncover the truth hiding within.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: Cartographer’s Tools or Navigator’s Tools

content.text: Seeking out the forgotten places of the world often brings one face to face with the dangers which lurk there. It pays to be prepared and ready.
Source: Mythic Odysseys of Theros
You have honed your body to the heights of mortal capacity. You compete in physical competitions of skill and might for wealth and glory.

items.text: Tool Profiencies: One gaming set of your choice

content.text: Athletes often sway crowds through the sheer force of the personality in addition to their performance. Rigorous training and immense strength are deadly tools when utilised in combat.
Source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space
You were an etheric drifter upon the Astral Sea, untouched by time.

items.text: Tool Profiencies: One musical instrument of your choice

content.text: Your travels within the Astral Sea have imbued you with fortitude and clarity. You have learned much upon the etheric currents.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You spent years as a cog in the grand machine of Ravnican legal bureaucracy.
Your time as a functionary has sharpened your mind to a keen edge and equipped you with a shrewd understanding of others.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You have spent years defending the down-trodden of Ravnica, battling those who would do innocent people harm.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set

content.text: You are the mailed fist of justice and order. Sometimes your presence alone is enough to dissuade your foes.
Source: Acquisitions Incorporated
You were born into the shadow of your parent(s) and their deeds. You have decided it is time to write your own story.
You likely had a privileged upbringing due to your family name and status. Your parents were keen for you to develop as many skills as possible.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have studied under a renowned Dwarven crafter who took you on as an apprentice.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: You have developed your body and mind throughout your training, and you are more well-rounded than most.
If you don’t want to use Crafter because it’s a terrible feat, consider Skilled instead.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have spent years in the safety of your scholarly shelter but now it is time to experience the world beyond your books.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: History, plus your choice of Arcana, Nature, or Religion

content.text: You have learned much from your studies, including some basic magic to help you in your travels.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have made a name for yourself among the influential circles of your home, breaking bread with the upper echelons thanks to your position.
You learned many things from your time as a member of your organization, including the importance of knowing someone’s true intentions – and manipulating those intentions if necessary.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You have guarded the interests of House Dimir from the shadows, ensuring your missions could not be traced back to your employer.
You are adept at blending in, whether skulking through the shadows or hiding in plain sight.
Source: Baldur’s Gate: Descent Into Avernus
You are a person of duality and hidden truths. You have created a persona to mask your true identity and purpose.
You are always wary of those who would seek to unmask you, and you have developed a keen awareness of threats.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You are an agent of one of the powerful factions which operate along the Sword Coast region.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Insight and one Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skill of your choice, as appropriate to your faction

content.text: An agent of one of the many factions pursuing their own agenda across the Sword Coast.
Suggested Origin feat: Skilled (Harpers, Lord’s Alliance, and Zhentarim), Savage Attacker (Order of the Gauntlet), Magic Initiate (Druid) (Emerald Enclave).
As each faction and their agents are so different, it is best to work with your GM if you are unsure what skills your character may have developed during their time with a faction.
Source: Acquisitions Incorporated
You tried your hand in the markets but unfortunately they chewed you up and spat you out. Your determination and tenacity to succeed are useful adventuring traits.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: You have invested a great deal of time and effort into improving your skills, including how to understand, and influence, people.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have travelled far from your homeland to seek adventure in the wider world.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: Any one musical instrument or gaming set of your choice, likely something native to your homeland

content.text: To have successfully travelled alone for so long means you have good situational awareness in addition to robust physical attributes.
Source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight
You were once a lost child in a strange and twisted realm, now returned to their home – but not unchanged

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: Any one musical instrument

content.text: It is no mean feat for one so young to survive in the wilds, let alone the nonsensical realm of the Fey. You learned quickly and it saved your life.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh
You were raised on the sea, spending your time either on shore or upon the waves as you learned to bring home the biggest catch.
Your body has grown strong and tough from your years at sea, and you have learned to sense the subtle signs which indicate danger is near, be it a squall or a shark.
Source: Basic Rules (2014)
Though your origins are humble, your destiny lies in the legend you will forge. The common people of your home regard you as their champion.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One of artisan’s tools

content.text: As the protector of your home you have learned to sense danger well-before it appears. You have lived a life of honest labour amongst your community, your body is strong and your people love you.
Source: Acquisitions Incorporated
You’ve always made your way in the world by taking risks. Usually those risks pay off, but if they don’t there’s always next time.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: Any one gaming set

content.text: Your gambling has often got you into a tight spot, so you’ve learned to keep an eye out for danger and know when to walk away…and when to run.
Source: Planescape: Adventures in the Multiverse
You’ve stood guard somewhere with extraplanar portals for so long that the fantastical has become pedestrian for you. There is little that will shock or surprise you at this point.
You’ve seen things that would make the common folk of this realm faint with fright or become completely enraptured. Though you’re hard to surprise, you’re always alert and ready.
Source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
You were taken in by Giants from a young age, learning their ways and gaining a portion of their strength.

items.text: Tool Profiencies: One set of artisan’s tools

content.text: The primal fury of giants dwells within you, straining to be unleashed upon those who would do you and your fellows harm.
Source: Player’s Handbook (2014)
You were a champion of the arena, your name roared by bloodthirsty crowds as you battled your way to fame and glory.
In the arena your survival depends on how quickly you can land the killing blow.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You were one with the Golgari swarm, traversing the hidden paths of the city.
You have learned much in your time within the swarm, and these skills will serve you well on your adventures.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You have lived on the fringes of urban society, dwelling amidst the ruins of civilization for many years.
Surviving in the urban wilds has sharpened your senses and heightened your reactions to avoid danger.
Source: Player’s Handbook (2014)
You were a skilled crafter of goods, selling your wares wherever you could.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: You have developed the skills of your craft throughout your career, including how to sell your creations to others.
Source: Curse of Strahd: Character Options
A powerful darkness haunts your steps. An indelible mark upon your very being which threatens to overcome you, unless you can defeat it.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Choose two from Arcana, Investigation, Religion, or Survival

content.text: Those who carry such a burden possess incredible fortitude, yet the temptation to unleash their dark fury is always present.
Source: Wayfinder’s Guide to Eberron
You have spent years in the service of your House, always working towards the goals of your masters.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One set of Artisan’s tools

content.text: Your skills have proven your value to your House over your years of service. You have also become adept at navigating the social politics at play.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have been entrusted with an artifact of great importance, and destiny calls you to your fate as its bearer.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Survival, and one from Arcana, History, or Religion
Tool Proficiencies: Your choice of one gaming set or musical instrument

content.text: To be a bearer of such great power is a perilous duty. One must always be alert and ready.
Source: Van Richten’s Guide to Ravenloft
You spent years seeking the truth when others lived in ignorance.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, or Perception
Tool Proficiencies: Disguise Kit, Thieves’ Tools

content.text: In your experience it always pays to be prepared. To that end you have developed skills in many areas you have found useful during your investigations.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You were a member of the Izzet League, and you embody the qualities that organisation is best known for. You are obsessive, brilliant, inspired…and unpredictable.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: Your skills were valued by the Izzet League and they nurtured your potential.
Source: Player’s Handbook (2014)
However you acquired your title, you now bear the responsibility of ensuring upholding the honor of it and your family’s name.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set

content.text: Throughout your youth you had access to more advanced education than the common folk, and gained some useful skills during your tuition.
Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
You have trained to be a valiant warrior who defends the weak and opposes evil wherever you find it.

items.text: Tool Profiencies: One type of gaming set or musical instrument

content.text: Evil will not be vanquished by words alone. It must be annihilated by strength of arms.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You spent years amongst your Order, fulfilling your duties within the organisation as best you could. Now it is time for the next step.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Persuasion, plus one from Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion depending on your Order.
Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set or musical instrument

content.text: Though the members of your Order bear the title of Knight there are many non-martial disciplines and skilled roles within it.
Source: Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos
You have studied the history of the world, focusing on the role of magic, in the hope of one day studying at Lorehold College.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One set of artisan’s tools

content.text: You have spent many hours studying the theory of your discipline and gained some basic magical skills from your endeavours.
Source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen
Your magical talents came to the attention of the Mages and you were trained to control them. However, you have not yet undertaken your final trial to become a full member.
You have learned much during your training, studying under some of the most renowned magic-users of the land.
Ghosts of Saltmarsh
You were trained to survive the most brutal conditions imaginable, battling through blood-stained surf to take the beaches of your enemies.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: Carpenter’s Tools, Cartographer’s Tools

content.text: Your training and experience has hardened you into a living weapon, capable of incredible violence when necessary.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have spent years as a member of a travelling mercenary company.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set

content.text: You’ve made your living by the strength of your sword-arm, but you’ve also picked up some useful skills, including how to negotiate a price for your services.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You have been a functionary within the Orzhov Syndicate for years, quietly watching and learning the ways of power and influence.
You have learned a great deal during your time within the Syndicate, and you possess a plethora of useful skills.
Source: Player’s Handbook (2014)
You have sailed the oceans of this world many times over, proving your mettle as a sailor and outlaw.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: Any two of Carpenter’s Tools, Navigator’s Tools, and Weaver’s Tools

content.text: You have battled the elements, other crews, and monsters of the blackest ocean depths during your career. You are well-equipped to deal with most things.
Source: Acquisitions Incorporated
You were injured by Acquisitions Incorporated operatives and planned to take legal action against them. Then they offered you a job.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: After your incident you have been extra-careful, always on the look-out for danger, to avoid being injured again.
Source: Planescape: Adventures in the Multiverse
You have spent years pondering the greatest mysteries of the planes, and now you seek to enlighten others with your musings.
Your studies and introspection have led you down some interesting paths. You have acquired skills in several areas via your experiences.
Source: Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos
You have always loved creating art, and have been honing your craft your years in preparation to study at Prismari College.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of musical instrument or artisan’s tools

content.text: You have gained many skills through your pursuit of excellence in art, some of which have multiple applications.
Source: Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos
You have spent years working through the recommended mathematical problems of Quandrix College in the hope of one day studying in that prestigious institution.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: As a student of the fabric of reality and the patterns therein you often notice details others might miss.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You have spent years honing your performance skills to the highest level. You delight in the screams of the crowd both during, and after, the show.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of musical instrument

content.text: You have shaped your body into an instrument of both performance, and violence, in service to Rakdos.
Source: The Book of Many Things
You were the recipient of some unexpected good fortune which transformed your life for the better.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One gaming set of your choice

content.text: Equipment: 50 gp
You have been favoured by the whims of fate. Such rewards often come with surprising benefits one can’t quite explain.
Source: Acquisitions Incorporated
You decided that your talents were not appreciated by your old employer and you have approached Acquisitions Incorporated to leverage your experience into a job with them.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools

content.text: You developed professionally over your time with your previous employer and you now possess a robust skillset.
Source: The Book of Many Things
Your life of luxury and plenty has been taken from you, now you have to make your way in the world by delving into dungeons.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One gaming set of your choice

content.text: Keen to avoid any further misfortune, you are always alert and wary.
Source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
You have spent years learning the ways of rune-carving, and harnessing the power that lies within such symbols.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One set of artisan’s tools

content.text: Your disciplined study of your craft has allowed you to gain some magical abilities.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
You have spent years within the blessed community of the Selesnya Conclave, ensuring balance and harmony reign in Ravnica.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of artisan’s tools or a musical instrument

content.text: You have learned some basic magic from some of your fellows in the Conclave, and you have learned to sit in the stillness between moments.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh
You have always loved the water, and you have spent years improving your skills to craft vessels worthy of your vision. You have also spent time on warships, ensuring they stay fit for purpose.
You have learned a great many skills over your career, either to fill gaps in your own knowledge or from those you have worked with.
Source: Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos
Your belief that words hold ultimate power has led you to prepare rigorously for your studies at Silverquill College.
You have learned how to skillfully apply your mastery of language to influence others.
Source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica
As a member of the Simic Combine you have strived to maintain the balance between society and nature via your scientific experiments with biomancy and terraforming.
Your line of work demands skills from multiple disciplines, which you have dutifully developed.
Source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh
You have made your living transporting and selling illicit goods on your vessel, but now your life takes a surprising turn.
In your line of work it pays to be perceptive. It’s always good to know if someone is planning to betray you, so you can do it first.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have made your living by hunting people down for paying clients, though strictly in your home, never out in the wilds.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Persuasion, and Stealth.
Tool Proficiencies: Choose two from one type of gaming set, one musical instrument, and Thieves tools.

content.text: You are always alert, ready for action at a moment’s notice.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You have always followed the ways of your people, eschewing the comforts of society in favor of a hard life in the wilds with your tribe.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of musical instrument or artisan’s tools.

content.text: You are hardy and capable, especially when traversing the wild places of the world.
Source: Sword Coast Adventurer’s Guide
You are a member of one of the noble houses of Waterdeep, eager to prove your worth to your family.

items.text: Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set or one musical instrument

content.text: Your privilege has afforded you opportunities out of reach for most.
Source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space
You were raised in Wildspace and it has toughened you like an old, sturdy boot.
In the void it pays to be alert. Danger can come from anywhere, at any time.
Source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight
You have been behind the scenes of the Witchlight Carnival for years, ever since you crept in as a youth. However, you’ve grown bored and seek new adventures.

items.text: Skill Proficiencies: Performance, Sleight of Hand
Tool Proficiencies: Disguise Kit or one type of musical instrument

content.text: Your time amongst the Carnival folk has helped you develop a range of useful skills.
Source: Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos
You have always loved performing alchemical experiments ever since you were a child. You hope to study at Witherbloom College to hone your craft.
You have learned some basic magical skills during your experiments, and developed a steady, practised hand for conducting your research.
